cohort: 123 pregnant women in their third trimester, with 30 cases of severe or critical COVID-19 and 93 cases of mild to moderate COVID-19
finding: Pregnant women with severe COVID-19 pneumonia requiring ICU admission had higher mortality, postpartum complications, longer hospital stays, and increased cesarean delivery rates compared to those with mild to moderate COVID-19.
mod_finding: Pregnant patients with severe COVID-19 were more likely to undergo Cesarean section delivery (80% vs. 40.8%; p = 0.01) due to COVID-19 progression.
